title: Non-anchor position spacing prediction
rationale: This lane predeclares a position-only spacing rule before adding candidate key material, routes, or fragment-value scores. It is intended to test whether future independently obtained K4 observations show repeatable spacing or delta structure rather than reusing already mined public clue alignments as evidence.
prediction_target: Future independently obtained non-anchor K4 position observations should show enrichment in predeclared spacing or delta residue classes for the registered modulus set before any candidate-word or key-material tuning is performed.
discovery_inputs: Registered modulus set fixed before evaluation: 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 13
Deterministic spacing and adjacent-delta residue-class rule emitted before observing new evidence
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
A committed held-out non-anchor position set not derived from prior clue alignments
controls: multiple-comparison correction across registered moduli and spacing classes
